svg.aria-label: A camera framing a sphere of radius r around the scene's bounds: the view's edge touches the sphere at a right angle to the radius, so the camera, the sphere's centre and the touching point make a right triangle. sin theta = r / d, so at theta = 30 degrees, d = 2r.
